name: Tile
description: A selectable tile/card for option selection, similar to a large radio button or checkbox. Keyboard accessible with Enter and Space activation. Visually communicates selected and disabled states.

notes: The tile renders as a div with role='button' and aria-pressed reflecting the selected state.
Enter and Space toggle the selected state.
Disabled tiles have aria-disabled='true' and are not focusable.
Focus indicator uses var(--color-border-focus) with a 2px solid outline.
Selected state is communicated via both a visual border change and aria-pressed.

selected.description: Whether the tile is in the selected state.

onChange.description: Callback fired when the tile is toggled. Receives the new selected state.

children.description: Tile content — label, description, icon, etc.

do: Use Tile for option selection where a larger touch target is beneficial.
Always provide meaningful content inside the tile so users understand the option.
Group related tiles together for multi-option selection patterns.
dont: Do not use Tile for navigation — use Card with clickable and href instead.
Do not nest interactive elements inside a Tile.
Do not use Tile for binary toggles — use Toggle instead.
